name: kkskills-situational
description: Situational working skills (10) — enable the plugin when the work calls for them: additive-first DB migrations, verify-with-real-data, clean-architecture, secret hygiene, concurrency/race-conditions, MCP server authoring, timezone handling, local-LLM selection, plan decomposition & orchestration (moved from kkskills-essentials in 0.2.0), and the meta-skill that folds new learnings back into a skill. Correct and maintained, just not everyday: every skill's description sits in context in every session, so these are kept behind one toggle. Skills-only.
